paragraphs: This is my photo page from the night zoo. My dad takes Leo and me. We travel there by a small train. It is seven o'clock, and the big lamps are off. Look at the first picture. This is the moon in the black sky. This is the small train, and Leo is on it. The zoo is quiet, but it is very exciting. Why is it exciting? Many animals are awake at night.

Now look at the second picture. This is a lion. It is awake, and it looks at us. It has a big head and a long tail. This is a bat. It is in a tree with its head down. It is small and brown. That is a parrot in a cage. The parrot is green and red. It is asleep, and it is quiet. What is the difference between a bat and a parrot? The bat is awake at night, but the parrot is asleep. The lion is bigger than both of them.

Here is the last picture. This is Leo with a funny hat. He looks up at the moon. The sky is black, and I can see many stars. This is my dad next to the train. He smiles and holds our bags. I like this picture best. At night, the animals are different from the day. What is your favorite animal at night?
text.summary: Mia shows her photos from a night visit to the zoo. Each sentence names one thing in a picture: a lion, a bat, a parrot, and the moon.
